notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Vampire Charmseeker.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
The Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
